messages:
maria g.: Heads-up  launch week handoff for the May benchmark + webinar. Need a compact SEO checklist we can hand to eng and growth: redirects, canonicals, meta A/B, schema, internal links, and inbound routing. Can we break ownership?
jordan: I can take the launch post meta A/B and keyword map. Will keep them short and testable.
lee (growth): Ill own inbound routing, UTMs, and form wiring. Which form fields are required?
anya: Ill do the redirect + canonical plan. Quick ask: prefer keep-old-paths as 301->resources when possible to preserve backlinks.
seo-bot: quick crawl: 7 pages collide on "serving LLMs" intents. Recommend one canonical hub (webinar landing) + 301s for deprecated previews.
maria g.: Form fields: email, first_name, last_name, company, role, interest_level (low/medium/high). Campaign id = rw-webinar-may-2026. Webhook target: Pardot (use growth secrets).
lee (growth): UTMs: utm_source=newsletter | utm_medium=email | utm_campaign=rw-webinar-may-2026. On-submit -> Pardot webhook tag=rw-webinar-may-2026 -> then SFDC lead via zapier (zap id zap-92).
jordan: Keyword clusters (compact): ["inference cost", "real-time LLM serving", "private inference", "dedicated GPU pools"]. Suggested anchors: natural phrases, avoid over-optimizing exact-match. One exact-match anchor per page max.
anya: Redirects sample (CSV for eng):
old_path,new_path,status,reason
/preview/inference-cost,/events/webinar-may-2026,301,merge previews
/blog/deep-inference-guide-2019,/resources/benchmark-2026,301,consolidate
/docs/legacy-serving,/docs/serving-runtime,301,doc restructure

and netlify/_redirects style (eng prefers):
/preview/inference-cost    301    /events/webinar-may-2026
/blog/deep-inference-guide-2019    301    /resources/benchmark-2026
/docs/legacy-serving    301    /docs/serving-runtime

seo-bot: JSON-LD event snippet (paste into <head>):
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Serving LLMs in Production","startDate":"2026-05-12T17:00:00Z","endDate":"2026-05-12T18:00:00Z","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://www.redwood.inference/events/webinar-may-2026"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}

seo-bot: optional FAQ schema for the benchmark post (two Qs) to increase rich snippet chance.
anya: canonical policy: landing page gets rel=canonical for any preview/draft derivatives. If a preview has >50 external backlinks, flag for manual review before redirect.
maria g.: Internal linking: build 6 contextual links from product docs + two from high-traffic benchmarks -> landing + launch post. GA4 filter: prioritize pages with sessions >300/mo.
jordan: Meta description variants (short):
A: "How top teams cut inference cost while keeping latency low. Join our webinar + get the benchmark report."
B: "Low-latency LLM serving patterns and cost benchmarks. Webinar + data-backed playbook."
lee (growth): Routing QA: set test webhook, submit test lead, confirm Pardot tag and SFDC lead creation. Also confirm thank-you page has noindex until post-launch.
eng-bot: FYI: staging crawler will validate 301s + canonical headers post-PR. Please include test cases in the PR description.
anya: PR plan: include CSV mapping, netlify/_redirects, canonical tag changes, staging test checklist, rollback steps. Will call out any URLs with high referring domains.
maria g.: Prioritization: 1) redirects/canonicals (anya) 2) routing & forms (lee) 3) meta A/B + keywords (jordan) 4) schema + FAQ (seo-bot) 5) internal links list (maria). Reconvene tomorrow 9am PT to sign off. :rocket:
seo-bot: post-launch watchlist: impressions (Search Console), CTR lift for A/B meta, crawl errors, and drop in organic sessions for redirected pages.
lee (growth): Ill add the routing steps + webhook creds to Notion and ping eng for staging test creds.
maria g.: Thanks team  please drop final artifacts in the launch folder and tag me.
